name: Forgotten 13
source:
You’re a reporter chasing a 1967 disappearance of 13 people. Every lead points to a small suburban house and the strange woman living there. Dig deeper, ask the right questions, and expose the truth.

[From [url=https://aaron-wise.itch.io/forgotten13]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名记者，正在追查1967年13人失踪事件。每条线索都指向郊区的一座小房子和住在那里的陌生女人。深入挖掘，提出正确的问题，揭露真相。

[来自[url=https://aaron-wise.itch.io/forgotten13]Itch.io[/url]]
